links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-facing acute pancreatitis responses versus recommended thresholds
links.effect: Best Flesch Reading Ease 44.42 ± 12.27 (DeepSeek-V3.2) versus recommended ≥80; none of 120 responses met all six readability targets.
links.quote: None of the 120 responses satisfied all six predefined readability targets.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient materials relative to recommended level
links.effect: All model-level readability distributions differed significantly from thresholds toward poorer readability; best FRE 44.42 vs ≥80 recommended.
links.quote: All model-level readability distributions differed significantly from recommended thresholds in the direction of poorer readability.

links.outcome: Factual inaccuracies and clinical hallucinations in LLM responses on acute pancreatitis
links.effect: Factual inaccuracies and hallucinations each in 16 of 120 responses (13.3%); safety-risk signals in 7 (5.8%), all low risk.
links.quote: In the added safety analysis, factual inaccuracies and clinical hallucinations were each identified in 16 of 120 responses (13.3%), whereas clinical safety-risk signals were identified in 7 responses (5.8%), all of which were adjudicated as score 1 (low risk) under the predefined clinician-rated rubric; no moderate- or high-risk clinical safety event was adjudicated.

links.outcome: Visible transparency cues (sources, evidence support) in LLM responses
links.effect: Visible transparency cues remained limited across all models.
links.quote: Grok 4.3 achieved the highest mean DISCERN, GQS, EQIP, and JAMA scores, reflecting the strongest informational quality profile according to the predefined quality instruments, although visible transparency cues remained limited across all models.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality, safety, transparency, and readability of responses generated by five publicly accessible LLMs to patient-facing acute pancreatitis questions, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
